title: Walk to Nashville’s Coveted 12 South and Belmont
description:
Blackbird Manor is a beautifully remodeled 1930s cottage just 2 blocks from 12 South, 1 mile from Vanderbilt, and minutes to Broadway. This fully furnished 3BR/2.5BA home features adjustable beds, smart TVs, a dedicated office, high-speed WiFi, private gym, sauna, renovated kitchen, laundry, and keyless entry. Family-friendly with pack-and-play, high chair, and baby essentials. Walk to Nashville's best dining, shopping, and entertainment.

The space
Bedroom 1 – Primary Suite
Spacious primary suite featuring an adjustable California King bed, smart TV, generous closet space, and a private en-suite bathroom. The perfect retreat for relaxation after a day exploring Nashville.

Bedroom 2
Comfortable guest suite with an adjustable California King bed, smart TV, and ample storage. Designed to provide the same premium sleep experience as the primary suite.

Bedroom 3
Inviting guest bedroom with a queen bed, smart TV, and convenient access to the home's full bathroom. Ideal for additional guests, children, or extended stays.

Living Room
Warm and welcoming living space with comfortable seating and a smart TV, perfect for gathering with family and friends or relaxing after a day in the city.

Kitchen & Dining
Fully remodeled and stocked kitchen featuring modern appliances, cookware, dishes, and everything needed to prepare meals at home. Enjoy a dedicated coffee bar with a Keurig coffee maker and Breville Barista Express espresso machine, fully stocked with complimentary coffee. The separate dining room offers a comfortable setting for meals, entertaining, or working remotely.

Home Office
Dedicated workspace with desk, chair, and high-speed WiFi, making remote work or business travel effortless.

Private Gym & Sauna
Enjoy exclusive access to a private fitness room and in-home sauna, providing the convenience of wellness and relaxation without leaving the property.

Outdoor Living
Relax on the classic front porch or unwind on the newly built rear deck, perfect for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or an evening glass of wine.

Family-Friendly Amenities
Traveling with little ones? Blackbird Manor includes a pack-and-play with sheets, high chair, baby utensils, plates, bibs, and cups to make family travel easier.

Sleeping Arrangements
Bedroom 1: Adjustable California King Bed
Bedroom 2: Adjustable California King Bed
Bedroom 3: Queen Bed
Sleeps up to 6 guests comfortably.

I hope you enjoy Blackbird Manor and Nashville as much as I do!
